title: yukibana.json
description: A project's configuration: its build system, what the student's IDE shows, which files the student may not change, what the student never receives, and what a submission contains. Lives at the project root. docs/yukibana-json.md is the prose.

version.description: The shape of this file. Always 1; a future shape gets a new number.

kind.description: The build system. Chooses the build output no archive carries and the manifest checks the build makes.

readOnly.description: Globs of files the student receives but may not change. When a teacher assembles a submission, whatever the student sent under these paths is replaced by the teacher's version, and every change is reported.

hidden.description: Globs of files the student never receives: removed from the starter, and from the starter's copy of this file. When a teacher assembles a submission they are put back from the teacher's version, like readOnly. A pattern naming a directory covers everything under it; * stays within a path segment, ** crosses segments, ? is one character.

projectId.description: Written by `yukibana build` into the starter's copy of this file: the registry project a submission from this folder goes to. A course repository leaves it out.

include.description: When present, only paths matching these globs are submitted.

exclude.description: Globs never submitted: build output, editor state.

filename.description: What a packed submission is called on disk. The registry accepts a zstandard-compressed tar, whatever the name says.

maxBytes.description: The largest submission this project expects, in bytes. The registry has its own cap above which this cannot go.
